What’s going on (plain English)
Your files live here physically:

But Termux reports them through its sandboxed path:
swiftCopy code/data/data/com.termux/files/home/storage/downloads/MBRepoBatch_20251218/

Those are the same files.
Android’s file manager only shows the /sdcard / storage/emulated side.
